other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen or of Indian origin
Must possess a doctorate or equivalent in solar sciences/engineering, or an M.Tech/M.S. with strong published work and lab/industry experience (special case)
Minimum ten years of relevant experience, including time spent during Ph.D. research
Open to scientists employed in Government of India, State Government, public institutions, or unaffiliated but working in the solar energy field
Must submit a comprehensive research proposal as part of the application
benefits_summary: Selected Fellows receive an annual grant of up to ₹32 lakhs (covering emolument, contingencies, and research grant) disbursed to the host institution.
